defects.description: Card lacks visible border or shadow definition against the white canvas background
Horizontal spacing between bars is slightly uneven; bars appear slightly crowded relative to the card width

top_fixes: Add a subtle border (1px #e5e7eb) or soft box-shadow to the card container to define its edges against the background
Increase horizontal padding inside the card and ensure equal gaps between all six bars for perfect rhythm
Consider adding faint horizontal gridlines or a Y-axis baseline to give the bar heights more visual context

manifest.prompt: Create a card containing a bar chart titled 'Monthly Revenue' with six bars for Jan to Jun showing 12k, 18k, 15k, 24k, 29k and 33k, with value labels above each bar.
